evaluation_context.title: Phase 7.8 Actual External Chest X-Ray Dataset Evaluation & Performance Validation
evaluation_context.classification: Medical AI Generalization & Biostatistical Validation Protocol (Assistive CDSS)
evaluation_context.evaluation_outcome: PHASE 7.8 EXTERNAL EVALUATION: NOT PERFORMED (STOP CONDITION ENFORCED)

threshold_policy.rule: Primary evaluation relies on threshold-independent metrics (AUROC, AUPRC). Thresholds are strictly locked and never fitted on test data.

candidate_dataset_audit.storage_requirement: ~500 GB DICOM / ~40 GB High-Res Lossless PNG
candidate_dataset_audit.acquisition_blocker: Requires credentialed PhysioNet Data Use Agreement (DUA) and CITI research ethics training completion.
exact_acquisition_steps: 1. Complete CITI program course 'Data or Specimens Only Research' or 'Human Research Curriculum'.
2. Submit credentialing application on PhysioNet (physionet.org) under institutional affiliation.
3. Sign the VinDr-CXR Data Use Agreement acknowledging strict non-reidentification and no-distribution clauses.
4. Download test cohort via authenticated PhysioNet client (e.g. `physionet-build` or signed HTTPS tokens).
5. Mount dataset to local secure storage `storage_data/imaging/external/vindr_cxr/` with file permission lock.

candidate_dataset_audit.source_institution: Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein (Sao Paulo, Brazil)
candidate_dataset_audit.readers: RadLex-derived structured NLP labels on Portuguese radiology reports
exact_acquisition_steps: 2. Sign BRAX Data Use Agreement on PhysioNet.
3. Download de-identified DICOM/PNG files and annotations.
4. Ingest and validate partition integrity with `scripts/validate_xray_dataset.py`.

PLEURAL_EFFUSION.notes: Fluid collection with blunted costophrenic sulci.

CONSOLIDATION.notes: Alveolar airspace opacification with air bronchograms.

EDEMA.notes: Vascular congestion and Kerley B lines.

PNEUMOTHORAX.notes: Visceral pleural line with peripheral lucency.

PLEURAL_THICKENING.notes: Apical pleural capping or localized thickening.

PNEUMONIA.notes: Clinical syndrome manifesting as consolidation or infiltrates.

generalization_level.evidence: Software calculation harness verified (97/97 backend tests pass). Level 3 independent evaluation blocked pending physical acquisition and mounting of credentialed VinDr-CXR archive.

mandatory_safety_statement: NIDAN AI is an assistive Clinical Decision Support System. Even successful external benchmark performance does NOT constitute medical diagnosis, treatment recommendation, regulatory clearance, clinical deployment approval, radiologist replacement, or clinical validation. All model findings require independent qualified clinician/radiologist review.
